context:
Goal: a grant you type in one session reaches the session it names.
Problem (rule): the gate allows only owner messages from clients whose fields it has measured; only the desktop app is measured, so a grant typed on the web or phone does nothing. Only you can type from your own clients.
Based on (read): plan section 3, Design A step 5 (PR #1049).
Departs from: main — adds a gate that reads the client fields of your message.
lane: waits on item 285: on a, the test line becomes `grant grant-reaches-lanes spawn 15m`, typed in the coordinator from web and phone; on b, 221 closes

title: Type two test lines, one from the claude.ai web app and one from the phone app, so grants work from every client?
why: Two lines once, and grants then work wherever you type them.
